note: 082: the agents' value table, in credits, and the rates' one home (docs/card-pricing.md, *The rates*, describes them). First transcribed at r34, corrected against play at r35 (090: energy, antimatter, troop removal, liberation, the station flip, the income horizon); each op's row says what one unit is. Read by crates/aic-sim/src/agents/value.rs, whose match on Op is exhaustive: a new op does not compile without its arm, and a test fails until its row is here. Agent numbers, not rules: changing one changes no game's rules.

gain.per: the resource gained, at its rate

gain_per_node.per: the resource at its rate, per node (node_count when not known)

choose_player.per: the choice itself: what the other player gains is its own row

other_gain.per: the resource at its rate (a gift: they may not need it then)

transfer.per: the resource at its rate, up to max (it moves inside the team)

place_node.per: node (rates.node, node_late in the last late_rounds)

clear_markers.per: marker cleared: 2 Sway (board.clear_unity 2, r55) at rates.sway, plus 2 for the hex freed (target_share of it without a target in reach)

damage.per: the better of its kinds: ambassadors at remove_ambassador each, troops at remove_troop each

remove_ambassador.per: adversary ambassador removed in one hex (1 worth 2, 2 worth 5, 3 worth 6)

remove_troop.per: adversary troop removed in one hex (r35: about 20 in play, where a troop strikes facilities; r38: 15 less its Sway, alignment.troop 0, at rates.sway)

damage_country.per: a damage, in each hex of a country holding pieces (about one and a half hexes)

destroy_all.per: hex cleared of ambassadors and troops

remove_botnet.per: botnet removed (1 Sway, alignment.botnet 1 since r55, its compute, the block on claims)

remove_ambassadors_country.per: adversary ambassador removed in one country (max 0: token_pile), plus Sway at rates.sway

remove_troops.per: troop removed in one country: 11 each x 0.65 for being there

cleanse.per: factory cleansed; with cities, a city at liberate's row instead

cleanse_station.per: station cleansed, or a station or factory (r35: a flip, a cube a round both ways for the rounds left)

liberate.per: city liberated (5 Sway and a city, its ambassadors and Discord stopped: about 50 in play); no_city_share of it with no city corrupted

liberate_align.per: your cube on the liberated city

liberate_troops.per: troop the liberation may clear in its country (about 1.5 there, at remove_troops less its share; r38 x 0.7 with remove_troops)

liberate_botnet.per: a botnet on or next to the liberated city removed (remove_botnet x about 0.6 for one being there)

clear_city.per: adversary ambassador cleared around a corrupted city (max 0: token_pile)

move_ambassadors.per: ambassador moved up to its reach (149: no paid Move to buy one, so a card's move is a scarce one)

shelter.per: country sheltered this round (conditional on a destruction)

cordon.per: country cordoned: about 2 arrivals stopped; 178: its pool waits for the next Rally (was lost), so the Rally's are only delayed

free_building.per: building played paying no credits (a building's credits saved)

build_station.per: station built free (2 chips and about 3 cubes before its card completes)

claim_station.per: neutral station claimed by a card (142: 2 cubes a round at 3 for about 4 rounds, less the risk; the ambassador route is 3 ambassadors, 12)

project_cube.per: player cube on a megaproject (about 9 at completion, x 2/3 for completing)

jam.per: point of jam (x typed_jam with a source)

typed_jam.per: share of a jam that needs a threat of its type

production.per: the resource at its rate, each round left

production_per_tag.per: the resource at its rate, each round left, per `per` tags at play (106; rates.tag_count when not known: 5, the strategist's median count before a per-tag card's play, 128; a card counts its own tags too)

add_tokens.per: token added, at its tokens.feed_<kind> rate

cut_botnet.per: botnet's compute skipped for a build

spread_ambassadors.per: each of your ambassadors may step (about two, at move_one)

consolidate.per: ambassador gathered (149: up from 1 with the paid Move gone)

convert.per: 158: adversary ambassador converted (x target_share): remove_ambassador's 2.2, and an ambassador of yours on your node (armor, a blocker, moved later: 0.7 of resources.ambassadors)

gather.per: 166: piece gathered (x target_share): about 40% of a removal at the anchors (5); a strike reads remove_troop (troops among its pieces) or remove_ambassador per piece instead

firewall.per: 158: hex firewalled for an adversary turn: a Rally share (about 1.5 ambassadors, 3.3) kept off, and a Corrupt pull onto it stopped; 178: nor does the site corrupt that turn (about a seventh of liberate)

if_tags.per: 158: share of the worth of a 'with N X tags, also' rider (the chance the seat holds the tags when it plays)

drain_all.per: compute off every visible project: 1.1 x 1.5

gain_per_tokens.per: the resource at its rate, per `per` tokens of a pile (rates.token_pile when not known)

cash_out.per: the resource at its rate, times `rate`, per token of a pile (rates.token_pile when not known)

gain_per_tag.per: the resource at its rate, per `per` tags (rates.tag_count when not known)

sway.per: Sway at rates.sway, toward Unity; against toward Discord

troops.per: adversary troop placed (each country: x countries; 147: what one strikes in r61 play, 0.88 stations at build_station)

threat_at_node.per: tier of the threat dealt onto the most threatened node hex (deal_threats -7 a tier-1 or -2 threat, worse aimed at a node)

destroy_node.per: node the nearest player destroys (146: a threat's; also a troop landing that destroys; at rates.node)

flip_station.per: station corrupted (r35: cleanse_station the other way)

corrupt_city.per: city corrupted (a liberation the other way)

create.per: adversary ambassador a creation line places, on each site in each country it reaches

rally.per: adversary ambassador a Rally lands on each board (151; an event's: its pool)

increase_income.per: compute a round of an income rise, each round left; an ambassador a board a round counts 2 compute a board (151)

create_site.per: neutral site opened in each country (a target both sides contest)

corrupt.per: a Corrupt X line (about one site a game in reach of corrupting, a liberation the other way)

lose_node_or.per: the cheaper of a node and the payment

flag.per: a round flag: against for blackout, sabotage and embargo; shelter and cordon at their rows

requisition.per: the cheaper of the cards (rates.drawn_card each) and the payment

team_income.per: the resource at its rate, each round left, for every player

pushback.per: adversary ambassador removed, in each country

adversary_cubes.per: 185: adversary cube on each open megaproject (its payout: 1 Sway to Discord at rates.sway on three cards, 1 compute on one; less a little for bringing the completion a cube nearer)

botnet_cubes.per: 185: a botnet turned into an adversary cube: the botnet off (remove_botnets) and the cube on (adversary_cubes); its compute price is the project's, not this

one_player.per: 156: share of the worth of the ops one chosen player resolves (the team picks the best placed)

per_site.per: 167: share of the team ops' worth, once per site where the condition holds (rates.sites_expected, at most its max)

remove_where.per: 167: share of a piece's own row (pushback, remove_troops, remove_botnet, clear_markers, cleanse) x target_share, on rates.sites_expected hexes or each country or player

prohibit.per: 167: an adversary step off where its condition holds for one turn: about two Rally shares (3.3 each) or a corruption stopped (about a tenth of liberate) on the sites the players cover

income.per: the resource at its rate, a round

income_per_tag.per: the resource at its rate, a round, per `per` tags (rates.tag_count when not known)

building_discount.per: credit off, a round (about a building every other round)

harden_action.per: the Harden standard action open, a round

logistics.per: the resource at its rate, a round (a counter you paid toward lands about a third of rounds)

project_drain.per: compute off each project in upkeep, a round: 1.1 x 1.5

auto_counter.per: point off every threat of its type on the table, a round (148: wherever it is; r61 menus are one scarce currency, 3-7, or credits 12 / 17): 0.5 fires a holder-round x 12 credits a fire (a scarce option paid in full, about 3.5 units at the table) / 6 points (148: 0.41 fires a holder-round measured at r61, the strategist, with the cut 5 near the holder)

unity_bonus.per: extra Sway a troop removal, a round: about 0.3 removals x rates.sway

corruption_shield.per: a round: about one ambassador kept off your nodes

civic_shelter.per: a round: shelter's 4 x about 0.4 destructions stopped

wall.per: a round (an AI board's innate: never on a card)

patience.per: a round (an AI board's innate: never on a card)

supply_insight.per: insight handed out, a round: 2.5 x 0.75

tags_from_hand.per: a round: a discard that pays a power

convert_upkeep.per: what the conversion nets at the rates, a round (never below 0)

card_discount.per: 105: credit or insight (at its rate) off a play, a round: rates.fires_play plays, x rates.tag_share for one tag; 107: insight off every card x rates.insight_discount_share, the plays a discount floor of 1 leaves it to cut

when.per: 105: a trigger, a round: what one firing resolves (tokens here aside) x its rates.fires_<event> (plays at rates.fires_play, x tag_share for one tag, 107: in a game x the seat's own share, rates.own_mix with mix_prior cards at tag_share; a rebate at 1 - at/rebate_span); both players gaining: x (1 + other_gain)

threshold.per: 105: what the threshold resolves, a round: x rates.threshold_fill tokens a round / at; 107: a card whose own trigger adds the tokens fills at that trigger's rate (rates.own_fill 1; 0: threshold_fill), and an income the threshold raises counts rates.raised_rounds rounds a firing (0: none)

copy_income.per: 105: a copied building income, a round (about a typical building's Each round)

reuse.per: 105: another building's Action used again (about a typical Action's use)

discard_hand.per: 105: a card discarded (rates.hand_discards a use): the resource at its rate less rates.dead_card (a card you would sell)

standing_troops_bonus.per: the adversary board's difficulty line, never a player's

threat_compute.per: the adversary board's compute per uncountered threat (146), never a player's

compute_per_missing.per: compute a player without the resource gives

corp_troops.per: extra corp troop (more war, more Discord)

disable_building.per: building face down for a round

extra_war.per: a second war step on a front

lose_ambassadors_or.per: the cheaper of the ambassadors and the payment

lose_income.per: the resource at its rate, once

lose_or.per: the kinder of its options (a player's pick)

occupy_factory.per: a factory idle while the troop stands

troops_removed.note: 102 (D26): troops a 'remove up to N troops' removes in play, by N: the cards.remove_troops.<N> counters of 093's r36 read (1,008 games); an N not here counts as N. remove_troops' row is per troop removed; value.rs and scripts/cards/effect_ledger.py both read these.

overrides.why: 130: the table prices an ambassador removed in reach at 2 (anchor 5) and energy at its full anchor 4.5, so 3 removals for 2 energy read as a loss (get 1.5 against give 10.5); at the anchors a use nets 6. +11 puts its table get at 1.2 x its give.

130: the table prices a drawn card at 4 (anchor 5) and a chip at 1.5 (anchor 3) and energy at its full anchor 4.5, so draw 2 and 2 chips for 2 energy reads 7.1 against give 14.5; at the anchors 21.1 against 20. +10 puts its table get at 1.2 x its give (131: at chips 2, about 1.4 x).
